digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics surface, documentation, and agent skill
propositions: The rebar metrics command and registry exist but are not discoverable by agents or documented for users, reducing their utility as a code-health signal source.

rebar-janitor's Discovery phase currently uses one-shot snapshots (cloc, tokei, ast-grep, git log) but does not consult rebar metrics' historical trend data, missing the durable evidence the metrics registry provides.

The metrics surface lacks documentation explaining what the four lenses (agent_process, code_health, delivery, gate_economics) surface, the source/confidence labels, and the unavailable state for accruing metrics.

Documentation must reference rebar metrics in the janitor skill (discovery.md), user guide, agent navigation (AGENTS.md), and reusable registry surface (reuse-surface.md) to make the feature discoverable without code changes to the metrics command itself.
